map.按\"退货接收 / 质量检验 / 分类处理 / 记录追溯\"四大模块逐项自查退货: Check the returns reverse logistics process item by item against four modules — return receiving, quality inspection, sorting and handling, and record traceability — automatically computing each module's compliance rate and the overall process maturity, and outputting an improvement checklist.
map.流程成熟度 = 各项实得分 ÷ 满分 ×100%: Process maturity = Σpoints actually earned ÷ full score ×100%
map.每项按执行程度评分：未建立 0 分 / 已建立待完善 1 分 / 已建立并执行: Score each item by degree of execution: not established 0 points / established but incomplete 1 point / established and in execution 2 points
map.≥90% 流程完善，75-89% 基本完善，60-74% 待改进，<60% 需重: ≥90% process complete, 75-89% basically complete, 60-74% needs improvement, <60% needs rebuilding
map.逆向物流退货率建议控制在 5% 以下，过高需排查品控问题: The reverse logistics return rate should be kept below 5%; if it is too high, investigate quality control problems
map.📚 深度解析：退货逆向物流流程成熟度检查: 📚 Deep dive: Returns Reverse Logistics Process Maturity Inspection
map.电商大促后自查退货处理链路（接收、质检、分类、追溯）是否覆盖到位，输出改进清单。: After a major e-commerce promotion, self-check whether the returns handling chain (receiving, inspection, sorting, traceability) is properly covered and output an improvement checklist.
map.新仓或新团队接手逆向物流前做基线评估，并按模块达标率排定整改优先级。: Run a baseline assessment before a new warehouse or team takes over reverse logistics, and rank remediation priority by module compliance rate.
map.季度复盘时重复打分，用达标率变化验证整改措施是否落地。: Re-score during the quarterly review and use the change in compliance rate to verify whether remediation measures have landed.
map.四大模块共 20 项，每项未建立 0 分 / 待完善 1 分 / 已执行 2 分: The four modules have 20 items in total, each not established 0 points / to be completed 1 point / executed 2 points, for a full score of 40. If 12 items are executed (24 points), 5 are to be completed (5 points) and 3 are not established (0 points), the score is 29/40 = 72.5%, rated "needs improvement" (the 60–74% band). The tool lists the 8 items scoring below 2 points in the improvement checklist, and the 3 not-established items should be handled first.
map.评级区间怎么划分？: How are the rating bands defined?
map.达标率 = 得分 ÷ 40 × 100%。≥90% 流程完善、75–89% 基本: Compliance rate = score ÷ 40 × 100%. ≥90% process complete, 75–89% basically complete, 60–74% needs improvement, <60% needs rebuilding.
map.未建立 0 分、待完善 1 分（有动作但不规范或未留痕）、已执行 2 分（有制度: Not established 0 points, to be completed 1 point (there is activity but it is non-standard or unrecorded), executed 2 points (there is a system and there are records). All items below 2 points automatically enter the improvement checklist.
